subScenes.name: 礼貌打断
subScenes.description: 学员礼貌地向路人搭话，请求问路。

qaPairs.triggerText: Excuse me, could I just ask for directions to the restroom quickly?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 不好意思，能麻烦您快速告诉我洗手间怎么走吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客礼貌打断服务员的介绍，请求紧急问路

followUps.text: Of course! It's just down the hall to the left, past the kitchen.
followUps.text_cn: 当然！沿着走廊左转，经过厨房就是。

followUps.text: I'm sorry, I'm currently assisting another guest—could I point you there in just a moment?
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，我正在服务另一位客人，能等我一分钟再带您去吗？

followUps.text: Actually, our host at the front desk can help you better—I'll call them over.
followUps.text_cn: 其实前台的接待员更熟悉路线，我叫他们过来帮您。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于顾客在服务人员忙碌时礼貌打断并请求紧急帮助的场景，体现跨文化礼貌策略

qaPairs.triggerText: Sorry to interrupt, but could you tell me how to get to the nearest pharmacy?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 抱歉打扰一下，您能告诉我最近的药房怎么走吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客在餐厅用餐时突然需要药品，礼貌打断服务员询问

followUps.text: Absolutely—it's just two blocks east, across from the bank. I can draw you a map.
followUps.text_cn: 当然可以——向东两个街区，银行对面就是。我可以给您画张地图。

followUps.text: I'm not sure about pharmacies nearby—I recommend calling 911 for urgent medical needs.
followUps.text_cn: 我不太清楚附近药房，紧急情况建议拨打911。

followUps.text: We don't have that info on hand, but the front desk has a local guide—let me get it for you.
followUps.text_cn: 我们没有这方面的信息，但前台有本地指南，我去帮您拿一份。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于突发健康需求场景，学习者需掌握如何在非典型服务场景中礼貌请求帮助

qaPairs.triggerText: Pardon me, I hate to bother you, but do you know where the exit to the subway is?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 不好意思打扰了，但我实在不想麻烦您——您知道地铁出口在哪吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客赶时间，用高度礼貌语气打断服务员询问交通出口

followUps.text: No problem at all—it's through those double doors, then left at the escalator. You have 5 minutes before the next train.
followUps.text_cn: 完全没问题——穿过那扇双开门，然后在自动扶梯处左转。您还有5分钟赶上下一班地铁。

followUps.text: I'm not familiar with the subway exits—I suggest checking the digital map near the elevators.
followUps.text_cn: 我不太清楚地铁出口，建议您去电梯旁看数字导览图。

followUps.text: Actually, the exit you need is closed for maintenance—would you like me to call a taxi for you?
followUps.text_cn: 实际上您要的出口正在维修，需要我帮您叫辆出租车吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 强调在时间压力下使用高礼貌表达，同时学习服务员如何应对信息受限或突发状况

subScenes.name: 询问地点
subScenes.description: 清晰说出目的地，询问具体位置。

qaPairs.triggerText: Excuse me, could you tell me where the nearest bank is?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 打扰一下，能告诉我最近的银行在哪里吗？

followUps.text: Sure! It's just two blocks east, next to the post office.
followUps.text_cn: 当然！往东两个街区，就在邮局旁边。

followUps.text: Actually, there's an ATM inside the supermarket across the street — that might be more convenient.
followUps.text_cn: 其实街对面的超市里有ATM机，可能更方便。

followUps.text: I'm sorry, I'm new here too — maybe you could ask at the information desk down the road?
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，我也是刚来这儿，也许你可以去前面的信息台问问？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于向当地人询问银行或金融服务点位置，适用于旅游或新到城市场景

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you know how to get to the hospital from here?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你知道从这儿怎么去最近的医院吗？

followUps.text: Yes, walk straight for five minutes, then turn left at the traffic lights — it's the big white building.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，直走五分钟，到红绿灯左转——那就是那栋白色大楼。

followUps.text: The hospital is closed now — the emergency clinic is around the corner on Maple Street.
followUps.text_cn: 医院现在关门了，急诊诊所在拐角的枫树街上。

followUps.text: You should take a taxi — it's about 15 minutes away, and I can call one for you.
followUps.text_cn: 你最好打个车——大约15分钟车程，我可以帮你叫一辆。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于紧急或非紧急情况下寻找医疗机构，需区分常规服务与急诊

qaPairs.triggerText: Can you help me find the nearest pharmacy?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你能帮我找找最近的药房吗？

followUps.text: Of course! It's on the ground floor of this mall, next to the coffee shop.
followUps.text_cn: 当然！就在这个商场的一楼，咖啡店旁边。

followUps.text: There's a 24-hour pharmacy just two blocks away — it's open now if you need something urgent.
followUps.text_cn: 两个街区外有一家24小时药房，如果你急需药品，现在开着。

followUps.text: I'm not sure — but the front desk at the hotel downstairs might have a list of nearby pharmacies.
followUps.text_cn: 我不太确定，但楼下的酒店前台可能有附近药房的清单。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于购买药品、应急药物或日常用药需求，常出现在旅游或突发健康问题场景

subScenes.name: 确认方向
subScenes.description: 听清指引后，确认左右、前后等方位信息。

qaPairs.triggerText: Is the hospital north or south of here?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 医院是在这边的北边还是南边？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 确认方向：询问医院方位

followUps.text: It's north, about five minutes walk. Turn left at the corner, then straight ahead.
followUps.text_cn: 在北边，步行大约五分钟，转过拐角后直走。

followUps.text: Actually, it's south — I just saw a sign for it a block back.
followUps.text_cn: 其实是南边，我刚才在前面一个街区看到过指示牌。

followUps.text: I'm not sure — I'm new here too. Maybe ask at the information desk over there?
followUps.text_cn: 我不太确定，我也是新来的。要不要去那边的信息台问问？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于在陌生城市确认关键地点（如医院、银行）的相对方位，常伴随对方向的误解或信息模糊。

qaPairs.triggerText: Which way do I go to get to the bank? Left or right?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 去银行该往左走还是往右走？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 确认方向：询问银行转向

followUps.text: Go left — it's right next to the post office, you can't miss it.
followUps.text_cn: 往左走，就在邮局旁边，一眼就能看到。

followUps.text: Neither — you need to go straight and cross the street. The bank is on the other side.
followUps.text_cn: 都不对，要直走穿过马路，银行在对面。

followUps.text: The bank closed at 4 PM — it's already 4:15. Try the credit union down the road.
followUps.text_cn: 银行下午4点关门，现在都4:15了。试试街那头的信用合作社。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用户常因时间紧迫或地图不准而直接问左右，但真实回答可能涉及直行、过街或营业状态变化。

qaPairs.triggerText: Is the restroom down this hall or around the corner?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 洗手间是在这条走廊尽头，还是拐角那边？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 确认方向：询问洗手间位置

followUps.text: Down this hall — it's on the right, just past the elevators.
followUps.text_cn: 在这条走廊尽头，电梯过去右边就是。

followUps.text: Around the corner — but be careful, the sign is broken and it's easy to miss.
followUps.text_cn: 拐角那边，但注意，指示牌坏了，很容易错过。

followUps.text: There isn't one here — the nearest is on the second floor of the next building.
followUps.text_cn: 这里没有洗手间，最近的在隔壁楼的二楼。

qaPairs.usageNote: 洗手间是高频紧急需求，用户常因焦虑而简化问题（只问左右/直行），但真实回答可能涉及设施缺失或隐蔽位置。

subScenes.name: 重复确认
subScenes.description: 复述路线以确保理解正确，避免走错。

qaPairs.triggerText: So you're looking for the nearest subway station, right?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 所以你是想找最近的地铁站，对吧？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 餐厅服务员为顾客重复确认问路需求

followUps.text: Yes, that's correct — and is it walkable?
followUps.text_cn: 是的，没错——能步行到达吗？

followUps.text: Actually, I meant the hospital — did I say subway by mistake?
followUps.text_cn: 其实我是想找医院——我刚才说地铁是说错了吗？

followUps.text: Right, but could you repeat the directions? I didn't catch all of it.
followUps.text_cn: 对，但你能再重复一遍方向吗？我没全听清。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于服务人员在提供导航信息前，通过重复确认确保理解无误；用户可能确认、纠正或请求重述。

qaPairs.triggerText: You want to go to the bank across from the post office, correct?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你是想去邮局对面的银行，对吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 银行柜员为顾客重复确认目的地

followUps.text: Yes, exactly — the one with the green sign.
followUps.text_cn: 对，就是那个有绿色招牌的。

followUps.text: No, I meant the one next to the pharmacy — I got confused.
followUps.text_cn: 不对，我是说药房旁边的那家——我搞混了。

followUps.text: Actually, I'm not sure anymore — can you show me on the map?
followUps.text_cn: 其实我现在也不确定了——你能用地图给我指一下吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 服务人员在导航场景中常通过重复确认避免误导；用户可能确认、修正或因不确定而请求可视化帮助。

qaPairs.triggerText: So you need the exit for the emergency room, right?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 所以你需要去急诊室的出口，对吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 医院前台人员为焦急患者重复确认目的地

followUps.text: Yes, please — my child is having trouble breathing.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，拜托了——我孩子呼吸困难。

followUps.text: Wait — I think I'm at the wrong building. Is this the main hospital?
followUps.text_cn: 等等——我觉得我来错楼了。这是主医院吗？

followUps.text: No, I meant the pediatric wing — is that the same exit?
followUps.text_cn: 不是，我是想找儿科区——那是同一个出口吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 在医疗场景中，重复确认至关重要；用户可能因焦虑、混乱或信息模糊而做出不同反应，需体现情感与逻辑差异。

subScenes.name: 表达感谢
subScenes.description: 对路人帮助表示真诚感谢并告别。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 服务员指路后表达感谢，顾客回应

followUps.text: You're welcome! Have a great meal!
followUps.text_cn: 不客气！祝你用餐愉快！

followUps.text: No problem at all — I really appreciate it!
followUps.text_cn: 没问题，我真的很感谢！

followUps.text: Thanks again — you saved me!
followUps.text_cn: 再次谢谢，你救了我！

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于服务人员主动致谢后，顾客自然回应的场景，语气应真诚、简洁，避免过度正式或机械。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 服务员确认顾客是否顺利找到目的地后，顾客表达感谢

followUps.text: Yes, I found it! Thanks so much!
followUps.text_cn: 找到了！太感谢了！

followUps.text: Actually, I’m still a bit lost — could you repeat that?
followUps.text_cn: 其实我还是有点迷路，能再说一遍吗？

followUps.text: Perfect! You’re a lifesaver!
followUps.text_cn: 太完美了！你真是救星！

qaPairs.usageNote: 当服务人员确认顾客状态时，顾客的回应应体现真实情绪：满意、仍需帮助、或极度感激，避免只说‘Thanks’而无内容。

qaPairs.triggerText: Hope you find your table alright!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 希望你能顺利找到座位！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 服务员在指路结束时表达良好祝愿，顾客回应感谢

followUps.text: I will — thanks for being so kind!
followUps.text_cn: 我会的，谢谢你这么友善！

followUps.text: Thanks! I’ll come back and tell you how it went!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢！我会回来告诉你结果！

followUps.text: You’re awesome — I’m so glad I asked!
followUps.text_cn: 你太棒了，我很庆幸我问了！

qaPairs.usageNote: 此句常用于服务结束时的温暖收尾，顾客回应应体现情感温度，避免冷淡或仅说‘Thanks’。
